verdict.rationale: Ollama itself is a model runtime and has no native automation or scheduling feature. Background autonomous operation is reachable only through separate tools: OpenClaw, a personal assistant running on-device across messaging apps, and agents like Claude Code or Codex started via `ollama launch`. Docs mention throughput for running several agents at once, and one user describes a Discord bot backed by Ollama models. Missing for 10: first-party automation setup, scheduling or trigger configuration, background-run management, and documentation of autonomous workflows within Ollama itself.
